ADR-0016 section 5 repair orchestrator implemented: open/mitigated incidents without a ledger row are submitted as ordinary Agent repair tasks through Core's private AgentRepairTaskService (the standard Task Router admission chain - project binding provider, credential snapshots, queue/lease/deadline), one repair task per incident anchored by the reliability ledger (migration 035) plus the Agent idempotency mapping, and the incident projects the repair task id idempotently (make test-repair-deployment); ADR-0020 repair audit: the previous gate proved repair task submission only, not deployment. Candidate reconciliation now persists the exact version and expected project revision, pins before starting the surface and observation window, rolls back failed starts or fresh incidents, and serializes durable replay with database row locks. Unit tests and TestDeploymentReconciliationDurability prove these boundaries. Build/Test-to-candidate handoff and real container deployment evidence remain pending; task completion alone cannot promote a deployment. Deployment reconciliation now detects scoped incidents from candidate persistence through startup and canary; rollback requires the Core previous pin plus an active recovered Surface with stable command keys. Optional exact-version Surface preconditions bind create idempotency and reject concurrent installation changes; superseded session descriptors cannot replay credentials. Unit/race, real Connect and PostgreSQL cover startup faults, scoped time boundaries, failed recovery, restart/replay and closed-session refusal. Build/Test candidate production and full automated deployment E2E remain incomplete. Repair polling durably rotates by last poll time (nine-task PostgreSQL restart test), closes failed/cancelled terminal rows without deploying, verifies Core task provenance and preserves TaskID during candidate handoff; missing candidates remain pending without starving later tasks. ADR-0026: HandleRepairCompleted now advances through the verified chain — Core candidate read, Runtime Build/Test submit/poll (pending keeps the row, failed builds clear it with zero deployment side effects), staged registration and DeploymentController.Offer with the staged facts persisted in the deployment ledger (migration 052); promote drives the staged publish before marking promoted. make test-repair-buildtest drives the full coordinator on real processes (incident→repair→candidate→build→staged→canary→publish), proves failed builds clear with zero deployment side effects, restart recovery converges, and the deployment fault matrix (startup fault, canary incident, bounded rollback retries, duplicate offers) holds on the real Core staged lifecycle and durable ledger. A pre-existing ListRepairCandidates mapping regression (dropped AppInstanceID) that broke incident-driven repair admission was found and fixed by this gate.

modules.name: Indexer
modules.evidence: ADR-0013 durable review-artifact projection: Core private publication feed, transactional document/receipt/cursor effects, at-least-once replay, reconciliation, owner/project/source/digest-bound reads, source-filtered pagination, repair jobs and shadow-generation rebuild with crash resume and atomic promotion. Core remains the authority; Indexer never reads Core SQL. Gateway/Chromium and granted App knowledge-search gates cover scoped retrieval and revocation. ADR-0021 replaces the production feature hash with pinned multilingual-e5-small ONNX CPU inference owned by an Indexer child. The unified image contains verified public weights, tokenizer and fixed runtime; inference needs no network or Provider credentials. Migration 047 preserves documents/receipts/cursors and replaces only the derived vector cache with normalized pgvector(384) plus model fingerprint. Application inference runs outside database transactions. Bounded durable backfill conditionally writes only matching generation/source/digest/publication snapshots; missing or mismatched model vectors make hybrid search unavailable while lexical search stays usable. Exact SQL hybrid ranking has no 2000-candidate truncation; ranking-v3 tokens bind model identity and use score DESC / created DESC / UUID ASC. PostgreSQL/race proves migration preservation, five concurrent-change cases, complete 2102-document pagination, model-token refusal and promotion readiness. test-local-embedding proves real offline CPU inference and child failure/deadline handling; test-model-postgres proves three Chinese/English retrieval cases, identical ingestion/rebuild vectors and restart backfill rankings; test-semantic-knowledge proves real Gateway/Core/Indexer RPC. Workspace mounts use root-anchored openat2, bounded complete scans, UTF-8 validation, source-etag CAS and one transaction for documents/receipts/cursor/tombstones/status. Rebuild copies the latest live workspace set under the generation lock with explicit document/byte budgets, then requires complete model vectors. test-workspace-browser proves 23-file pagination, mixed review/workspace retrieval, exact snapshots, Chinese queries against English files with zero lexical hits, Indexer restart, rebuild preservation, stop refusal and owned-fixture cleanup. ADR-0017 archive remains a bounded content-addressed local-admin store (8 MiB/object, 200 objects/owner, media-type validation and sha256 dedup), outside search. Not covered: semantic chunks beyond the model's 16-KiB/512-token prefix, generated RAG answers, ANN indexes, knowledge graphs or multi-owner deployments. Workspace scans reuse validated vectors only for matching source/digest/title/model, using one bounded active-generation cache read outside the write transaction. test-workspace-model-capacity proves 1000 long-text files through the real CLI/CPU/Gateway/Chromium lifecycle: cold sync 290s, unchanged repeat 3s on the acceptance host, then stop and cleanup. The CLI sync budget is ten minutes (other admin requests remain 30s); cold inference is not advertised as instant.

modules.name: Mobile Shell
modules.evidence: Shared adaptive contract and responsive Desktop UI are verified through four-mode real Gateway/Core/Chromium tests and 40 layout/store/hook tests. The apps/mobile-shell package itself remains a library scaffold: main.ts mounts no UI, dist/index.html is absent, and Android/iOS platform projects have not been added. The 2026-09-07 real cap sync android probe fails with platform not added; this is missing software, not evidence of an Android SDK blocker. make test-mobile-wrappers now fails on these precise prerequisites and does not print PASS. Removed the unused native push POST helper: it had no canonical service contract or caller and used an unsafe loopback string-prefix check. Native push, secure-storage integration, file sharing, pairing and hardware acceptance remain unimplemented/unverified. The standalone optional key-store helper has an ephemeral web fallback test only; it does not establish native protection.

modules.name: Notification
modules.evidence: owner-scoped durable notification facts + monotonic change stream/read state + App quota/idempotency receipts (ADR-0014; Core migrations 029 and forward-only CREATED-revision hardening 031; reliability publication migration 030): Core producers join source transactions through a neutral tx-scoped sink, while PostgreSQL transaction locks arbitrate genuinely concurrent first producer/read/App requests. Snapshot page, unread count and owner-counter watermark share one repeatable-read view; continuation tokens retain the first-page watermark across concurrent inserts, sweep cannot regress it, and unread snapshots expose their positive CREATED revision (real-PostgreSQL regression evidence). Reliability incident facts arrive at-least-once over the versioned private claim/complete RPC; the live consumer probe starts/degrades fail-closed and bounded source calls recover/drain backlog, while make test-incident-notifications proves the software chain but not rootless supervisor acceptance. Gateway exposes exactly the public NotificationService with resumable bounded watch, heartbeat, per-owner budget, sweep-gap RESET_REQUIRED, pre-decode budget, dynamic device-session identity and bounded mid-stream revalidation. Desktop keeps only the latest 100 discardable in-memory facts, prevents stale refresh/revision rollback, and typed actions distinguish authoritative NotFound from transient failure. make test-notification-center proves live delivery, typed action and Gateway/Core restart catch-up; make test-lan-pairing additionally pairs two independent Chromium persistent profiles through the production TLS/session gate and proves notification arrival plus READ-only cross-device convergence. Granted-app notifications.create is negotiated from the exact grant epoch; Core locks Project/installation and reauthorizes before every replay, then atomically adjudicates idempotency/quota/projection, so uninstall/revoke and concurrent first quota requests fail closed without side effects (make test-app-notifications over an opaque-origin web bundle). Push outbox (migration 042) joins every notification source transaction; bounded leased at-least-once delivery, restart/replay/stale-claim rejection, quiet hours and revoked subscriptions are verified with PostgreSQL (make test-push-relay). Legacy attempts remain unknown. Web Push adapter implements RFC 8291 encryption and RFC 8292 VAPID using an owner-only key file; known-answer and local TLS tests pass. Browser worker shows generic messages and signals authoritative shell refresh; independent Chromium CDP delivery tests pass. Preference revision (043) prevents silent overwrite. Current-device endpoint digest and VAPID-key matching detect revoked/stale browser subscriptions; explicit reconnect, key rotation and partial-cleanup retry have UI unit coverage. Subscribe/Unsubscribe reject cross-device writes; PostgreSQL verifies owner/device digest isolation. Three-viewport evidence: docs/ui/desktop-web/changes/20260906-push-state/. make test-push-wake proves the isolated real Core outbox → strict-TLS RFC 8291/8292 receiver → first 503 → Core restart → retry → Chromium frozen-page wake → authoritative catch-up chain. Two notifications retain unique tags; overlapping worker displays are serialized and duplicate wakes are deduplicated. The gate creates and removes only its own database, keys and containers, uses development identity and Chromium push injection, and does not prove a commercial Push Service or native background delivery. APNs/FCM remain unavailable without external accounts. Device revocation now propagates from Gateway transaction outbox (045) through private DevicePushService to a permanent Core device tombstone (046). Stable device-scoped idempotency rejects timestamp drift; subscribe and revocation serialize. PostgreSQL integration/race tests prove failed-enqueue rollback, retries, lease takeover, lost acknowledgement, owner/target-device isolation and no late subscription revival. Production TLS paired-browser revocation, final explicit-key contract replay/race and make check pass.

modules.name: Codex Harness Adapter
modules.evidence: versioned local Codex App Server stdio JSON-RPC fixture (workos.codex.app-server/v1) runs as a real child of harness-host with an exact initialize protocol-version handshake, the adopted provider run identity, an ordered started→delta*→message→usage→completed canonical event mapping, bounded per-line output (1 MiB), bounded deltas, and exactly-once terminal semantics; capabilities declared honestly and proven (streaming, usage reporting, hard token budget, hard runtime deadline, enforced maxima, requires_task_credential_lease with required_credential_purpose codex-auth.v1); every run acquires a task-bound codex-auth.v1 lease over the Core mTLS execution channel and the lease secret reaches only the allowlisted child env; failure matrix proven at adapter level against the versioned fixture (mid-run crash, silent hang, out-of-order stream, over-budget truncation, deadline overrun all converge to deterministic terminals with no duplicated usage) (ADR-0015, make test-codex-harness: catalog honesty → credential-lease binding → real fixture task events → idempotent replay → Core+harness restart persistence → Chromium binding/run journey). Not covered: real Codex network service, OAuth credentials (API-key form only), structured artifacts or context refs (declared unsupported and refused)

modules.name: MCP Harness Adapter
modules.evidence: versioned local MCP stdio server fixture (workos.mcp-server/v1) runs as a real child of harness-host speaking initialize/tools-list/tools-call; the adapter declares the honest degraded subset — no streaming, no usage reporting, no provider budgets, no structured artifacts, no context refs, no credential path (a lease attached to its execution is refused) — so App-principal runs fail closed at the Task Router exactly like the Generic CLI; bounded per-line output, bounded time, deterministic terminal verdicts, and the failure matrix proven at adapter level (missing task tool, protocol-error, tool error, oversized line, hung call, mid-call crash) (ADR-0015, make test-mcp-harness: catalog degradation honesty → credential-free binding → deterministic blocking run → no fabricated usage → Core+harness restart persistence). Not covered: real remote MCP servers, streaming notifications, credential-bearing MCP deployments

modules.name: LAN Transport Discovery
modules.evidence: ADR-0019 LAN discovery is working end to end on the lan-pairing profile: the workos-mdns-announce compose service embeds the mDNS responder on host networking, advertising only the public origin plus the pairing-pinned TLS leaf fingerprint from the same certificate the gateway serves (fingerprint match by construction), and workosctl device scan browses the segment and lists only instances whose advertised fingerprint matches the pairing expectation in constant time, feeding the existing workosctl device pair flow (scan -> verify -> pair). make test-lan-pairing proves the discovery phase against the real TLS pairing stack (discovered origin https://localhost:8443); make test-mdns-discovery proves the announce/browse and constant-time verification plus forged-advertisement rejection. Relay and Overlay transports keep interface slots with honest unavailable status.
